info.title: MöB Trading API
info.description:
Create and manage paired positions through your bound venue accounts.

Create an API key in this environment and pass it as a Bearer token. Keys grant specific venues and a maximum USD size per leg; they cannot withdraw funds. Local and demo deployments can execute real trades.

Trading POST requests and binding submit require a persisted Idempotency-Key. Binding prepare uses a signed nonce. Reuse the same key, method, path and equivalent JSON when retrying an uncertain result. Keys are scoped to the wallet owner across API keys. HTTP 202 acknowledges a command; poll the task to observe execution.

Authenticated requests are limited to 120 per minute per key. Respect Retry-After on 429. Numeric database fields in task responses are decimal strings.

Direct perpetual orders are available on /v1/perp/orders for Hyperliquid, Robinhood Lighter, and canonical Lighter. Use market IOC orders for taker execution or limit GTC/post-only orders for quoting. Side long means buy; short means sell. Positions net at the venue. Use an opposite-side reduceOnly order to close exposure. HTTP 202 only confirms queue acceptance. Orders are asynchronous. Direct order routes run in the same API service as strategy routes and have their own 120 requests/minute/key budget, request logs, and owner-scoped idempotency namespace. Serve /v1/perp/* and strategy paths through the same API service and port.

Venue binding uses wallet signatures independently of API keys: prepare one or several explicit venue targets, sign the returned payloads, submit signatures, and poll the binding status. Funding-server executes persisted binding jobs. Private keys never leave the client wallet.

post.summary: Prepare one or several venue bindings
post.description:
Wallet EIP-191 message: `Mobius venue binding v1
domain=<BINDING_AUTH_DOMAIN or mobius-api>
action=<prepare or read>
payload=<canonical JSON>`, with actual newline characters and no trailing newline. Canonical JSON recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order, and contains no whitespace. Lowercase the owner. Sign the exact message; ECDSA wallets only. Prepare payload is {owner,venues,nonce,expiresAt}. Nonce is idempotent per owner: identical requests return the same sessions; changed content conflicts. Signature is valid at most 300 seconds; binding sessions last 10 minutes. Existing usable bindings return already_bound. Explicit rebind is required for unusable credentials, and active strategies/orders block it. Preparation is atomic; venue execution later permits partial success. This route uses wallet authorization in the JSON body and does not use Bearer authentication. Fee approval is included when server configuration enables it: HL uses a separate approveBuilderFee signature; Aster includes Builder/MaxFeeRate/BuilderName in ApproveAgent; both Lighter deployments use a wallet Mobius authorization followed by an L2 integrator transaction with four zero caps. Example base HL/Aster builder fee is 15 tenths bps (0.015%), doubled to 30 (0.03%) on strategy legs paired with Lighter; the approval cap is 0.1%, represented as "0.001" for Aster. Lighter indexes 994 and 735705 have zero extra integrator fee. See venue-bindings.md for configured builder addresses and full rules. Sign live prepare payloads; the response example contains illustrative values. Known Lighter integrator addresses: Robinhood index 994 maps to 0x494c2E39910a6d1929b65F06c734f4d873d733D6; canonical index 735705 maps to 0x327F0cBa516CA1B343978a3AC60448b33d95131c. Authorization targets the index, not the address. New requests check HL and Lighter target accounts before generating keys or saving a batch. HL uses userRole; Lighter uses accountsByL1Address and verifies ownership of the supplied accountIndex. Missing accounts return 422 venue_account_not_found; invalid Lighter ownership returns 403 account_not_owned. Lookup failure returns 503 venue_account_check_unavailable. Aster skips account-existence preflight. The worker submits its native signed agent/builder authorization and confirms both before storing a bound credential. First-time Aster preparation is permitted; existing credentials still require live verification for already_bound. Identical nonce replays reuse the original batch without repeating preflight. Lighter WASM signer chain IDs: Robinhood production 466324, canonical production 304, testnet 300. They are not settlement chain IDs. Incorrect prepared signing domains fail with invalid_signing_chain and require a new binding. Server-generated Lighter API-key slots use 5-254 excluding reserved slot 157; 0-3 are reserved and 4 is retained for legacy Mobius keys. API and funding servers must share DATABASE_URL, BOT_CREDENTIAL_KEY and venue/builder configuration. BINDING_AUTH_DOMAIN is a public prepare/read signing label that must match the client. Restart both servers after configuration or binding-code updates.

post.summary: Submit a list of venue authorization signatures
post.description: Sign each returned payload exactly and map it by requestId. An incomplete subset is accepted; a venue queues only when its required signatures are complete. All signatures must recover the batch owner. They authenticate this operation without Bearer authentication or an additional wallet signature. Persist and reuse the submission body and Idempotency-Key. Keys are scoped to bindingId; replay returns current state and still verifies signatures. Unknown/duplicate request IDs and signature replacement are rejected. Worker confirms external authorization before saving credentials; uncertain outcomes remain confirming, with no signed resubmission after session expiry.

get.summary: Read a binding batch with wallet authorization
get.description:
Wallet EIP-191 message: `Mobius venue binding v1
domain=<BINDING_AUTH_DOMAIN or mobius-api>
action=<prepare or read>
payload=<canonical JSON>`, with actual newline characters and no trailing newline. Canonical JSON recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order, and contains no whitespace. Lowercase the owner. Sign the exact message; ECDSA wallets only. Read payload is {owner,bindingId,expiresAt}. Pass its personal_sign signature using the wallet headers. A different authenticated wallet receives 404. This GET only reads persisted state. A read signature can be reused until its short expiry for the same binding. Batch results retain successful venues when others fail/expire. confirming may persist after expiry for uncertain external outcomes; continue polling or reconcile operationally.

BearerAuth.description: API key created in this environment: mobius_<uuid>.<secret>. Keep it in a local environment variable; never commit it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist one ID per intended mutation before sending. Reuse it with the same request for retries; different content returns 409.

limitPrice.description: Required for limit orders; forbidden for market orders. Must match the venue tick.

timeInForce.description: Market defaults to ioc and only accepts ioc. Limit defaults to gtc. post_only must not take liquidity.

slippageBps.description: Market orders only. Protection around the fresh execution mark, in basis points.

reduceOnly.description: Only reduce existing exposure. To reduce a long, use side short; to reduce a short, use side long.

expirySeconds.description: Queue deadline and resting-order lifetime from acceptance. Default 60 for IOC, 3600 otherwise. Hyperliquid resting-order expiry requires the worker to cancel; it is not a venue-native GTT.

resolution.description: Permanent operator reconciliation audit, or null for automated reconciliation. Includes the prior accounting, final reported fills, evidence, actor key ID, and timestamp.

filledBase.description: Total verified filled base quantity, including all previously recorded fills.

averagePrice.description: Weighted average execution price; null exactly when filledBase is zero.

evidence.description: Exact venue checks and trade references supporting the final result.

venues.description: Explicit distinct venue targets; all four must be listed to bind all. Array order is signed.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds between now and now + 300 seconds.

BindingSignRequest.description: Sign the exact live payload using method. EIP-712 types preserve venue-specific field order and capitalization. personal_sign signs payload.message as UTF-8, including decoded newlines. HL fee approval is separate; Aster fee approval is embedded; Lighter approveIntegrator is Mobius consent for a zero-cap L2 approval.

signRequests.description: Only outstanding unexpired signature requests; accepted signatures are never returned.
